name: runbook-k8s-drain-node
description: Cordon and drain a Kubernetes node (before maintenance, or when it is unhealthy): a baseline of what runs on it and which PodDisruptionBudgets apply, whether the rest of the cluster has room, human approval, the drain with k8s_control (it cordons, then evicts through the Eviction API so disruption budgets are respected - never forced), then verification that it is empty and the workloads are available elsewhere.

cluster.description: The inventory cluster (empty: the only one).

precheck.title: Pre-checks (what runs there)
precheck.prompt:
Pre-checks for draining node {{input.node}} (cluster {{input.cluster}}; reason: {{input.reason}}). Read-only: k8s_describe node/{{input.node}} (conditions, capacity, the pods on it), k8s_health for the cluster (other nodes Ready and schedulable? room for the moved pods?), and the PodDisruptionBudgets of the workloads on it (k8s_describe poddisruptionbudget/<name>: disruptions allowed now).

Report: the pods on the node by workload (DaemonSet pods stay), pods without a controller or with emptyDir data (a drain refuses them unless told), the budgets that could block it, and whether the other nodes can take the pods.

approve.title: Approve the drain

drain.title: Drain
drain.prompt:
A person approved draining node {{input.node}} (cluster {{input.cluster}}). Run k8s_control once with action drain, target node/{{input.node}}, reason "{{input.reason}}" - without force_unowned or delete_emptydir_data unless the approved baseline said those pods may go - and nothing else. If disruption budgets block it, do not force anything: report what is blocked.

Report: the tool's output.

verify.title: Verify
verify.prompt:
Verify the drain of node {{input.node}}.

Baseline:
{{state.precheck}}

Drain result:
{{state.drain}}

Read-only: k8s_describe node/{{input.node}} (cordoned, no pods but DaemonSet ones) and k8s_health for the cluster (the moved workloads available elsewhere, or Pending - and why). VERIFIED when the node is cordoned and empty of evictable pods and no workload lost availability it had before; otherwise FAILED (blocked by a budget is FAILED: say which).

Report: the checks.
